entry.title: Underground
entry.summary:
Author: lulustars28

Rating: MatureLanguage: EnglishWords: 87,754Chapters: 19/?Kudos: 21

Summary: There is one name in Gotham's underground fighting circuit that strikes fear in all fighters: "Red Hood".Jason Todd is Roman Sionis golden fighter, who has made him millions. To Roman, Jason is nothing more than property and profit. The only reason Jason is Roman's lapdog is to win money to put food on the table for him and his younger brother, Tim. The money is never enough, but it keeps them alive. Walking away has never been an option. Because years ago, Jason made a promise to someone who never came back. A girl he met in stolen moments between worlds—someone who made him believe, briefly, that Gotham didn’t have to be loneliness and survival. Someone who promised she wouldn’t disappear like everyone else. Then she did. No goodbye. No explanation. No way to find her again. Jason buried the memory the only way he knew how: by assuming she had chosen to forget him. Now she’s back. After four years abroad, Roman Sionis’s daughter has finally returned to Gotham. Jason sees her as a traitor due to her broken promises. She sees him as another one of her father's thugs. But how long can their past stay buried under contempt, and how long can it be before old feelings begin to rise to the surface?

entry.summary:
Author: lulustars28

Rating: MatureLanguage: EnglishWords: 14,106Chapters: 4/?Kudos: 4

Summary: Senior year was supposed to be simple. All she wanted was to graduate with her biology degree, spend time with her friends, and build a future with her longtime boyfriend. Instead, everything falls apart when she discovers her boyfriend Connor has been cheating on her, due to her not being as "experienced" as he would like, leaving her questioning everything—including her own confidence. Jason Todd has bigger problems than romance. As the star of the university hockey team, he's one failing grade away from losing the season he's worked his entire life for. Desperate to stay eligible, he needs a biology tutor—and the last person he expects to help him is his best friend Roy's younger sister. After an accidental drunk hook-up changes everything, they strike a deal: she'll tutor him, and he'll help her gain the experience she was lacking. But what starts as harmless practice soon turns into stolen moments, undeniable chemistry, and feelings neither of them planned for. With family secrets, broken trust, and the risk of losing the people they love most, they'll have to decide if some rules are worth breaking for a chance at forever.
